_about: How records from different tools are judged to be the same machine. Applied in code (src/core/dedupe.ts). Confidence values are editable defaults, not measured probabilities.

rules.label: Same hostname and a shared IP address
Same hostname, nothing else in common
Device display name equals a hostname
Shared IP address only (IPs get reassigned)

notes.conflict_keys: If two records both have one of these and the values differ, they are different machines, whatever else matches. MAC is not a conflict key because one machine can report different network cards to different tools.
notes.merge_threshold: Matches at or above this confidence merge automatically. Matches below it go to a person to review and are NOT merged.
